Indian police have arrested a 47-year-old Nigerian, Promise Chukwu, for allegedly supplying methamphetamine to information technology professionals in parts of Chennai, India. Chukwu was arrested after police reportedly seized 43 grammes of the illicit substance during a decoy operation on Pallavaram Radial Road in Chennai. According to India Today’s Video Desk on Sunday, police traced leads on the alleged drug supply network before deploying an undercover operative as a prospective buyer to apprehend the suspect. The report said Chukwu allegedly supplied methamphetamine around Tambaram, Mahabalipuram and Chennai Airport, with IT professionals among his suspected customers. Police also alleged that the Nigerian had remained in India beyond his tourist visa’s validity. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources Investigators suspect that he sourced the drugs from Bengaluru before distributing them to customers in the identified locations. Chukwu has been taken into custody for further questioning as investigations into the alleged drug supply network continue.
